idea: Benchmark the retriever on its own (MRR@10, nDCG@10, Recall@k, P50/P95 latency) before measuring the LLM output
problem_it_solves: Separates retrieval errors from generation errors; gives Proposal 6.4 concrete metrics
estimated_cost: Low: CPU, BM25 + one embedding model; 1-2 person-weeks
evidence_in_source: Dense best on BGL (MRR@10 0.690, nDCG@10 0.760, P95 772 ms); LAR-Rerank no better than hybrid on BGL
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: Needs relevance labels; RCAEval has fault labels per case, not relevance judgements, so labels must be derived (same root service / fault type)

idea: Ablate retrieval: none vs BM25 vs dense vs hybrid, same LLM, paired test (McNemar) on per-case correctness
problem_it_solves: Tests whether RAG actually helps localization instead of assuming it
estimated_cost: Medium: 4 configs x N cases x LLM calls; feasible with a 7-8B local model
evidence_in_source: RAG did not beat non-RAG; MiMo dense RAG -12.3 pp (p=.003); BM25 best RAG config 70.3%
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: Source cases are text narratives; RCAEval cases are telemetry, so the 'document' to retrieve (past incidents, runbooks) must be built

idea: Activate retrieval only when the diagnoser is not confident (confidence-gated RAG)
problem_it_solves: Avoids the harm of irrelevant context while keeping benefit on hard cases
estimated_cost: Medium: needs a confidence signal (see I06, I08)
evidence_in_source: not-reported (proposed, not tested in source)
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: No evidence yet; risk that confidence of small LLMs is poorly calibrated

idea: Use half of the labelled incidents as historical case base and the other half for evaluation; compare semantic vs keyword case retrieval
problem_it_solves: Gives a leak-free protocol for case-based retrieval on public benchmarks
evidence_in_source: F1 0.952 with RAG vs 0.874 with keyword retrieval on Nezha; 0.828 vs 0.663 on private power data
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: RCAEval RE2 has fewer cases per system/fault type than needed for a large case base; split per system

idea: Adaptive number of retrieved cases instead of static top-k
problem_it_solves: Static top-5 may inject irrelevant cases
evidence_in_source: not-reported (future work in source)
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: Unknown benefit; must be compared to fixed k

idea: Report calibration: ECE, prediction-set size and coverage, plus few-shot curve k=1..100
problem_it_solves: Answers 'how sure is the system and is that number trustworthy'
evidence_in_source: ECE and coverage reported alongside Top-1/3/5 accuracy (values not captured in the extraction record)
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: P42 calibrates a fusion with GPT-4; a small local LLM may give flat/overconfident scores

idea: Estimate LLM uncertainty from several samples at different temperatures (sampling variance)
problem_it_solves: Gives a confidence score without logits
evidence_in_source: Part of the fused uncertainty in P42 (no separate ablation extracted)
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: Cost multiplies; must be bounded (fewer samples) on student hardware

idea: Small model with Bayesian uncertainty decides when to call the LLM
problem_it_solves: Cuts LLM calls and latency while keeping accuracy
estimated_cost: Medium: train a small classifier/ranker per system
evidence_in_source: LLM called only for uncertain samples; accuracy and call ratio in Sec 4.2 Tables 1-2
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: Source task is log classification; RCA needs a small ranker (e.g., a non-LLM RCAEval baseline) as the cheap stage

idea: Keep a base of past error cases of the cheap model and retrieve them as hints for the LLM
problem_it_solves: Teaches the LLM the cheap model's typical mistakes
evidence_in_source: Part of AdaptiveLog; ECR retrieval latency noted as slow
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: Few cases per fault type in RCAEval

idea: Bound the context per reasoning unit (per span/service) to avoid context explosion
problem_it_solves: Large telemetry does not fit one prompt
evidence_in_source: Evaluated on AIOps 2022, Augmented-TrainTicket and RCAEval RE2-OB against 8 baselines (numbers not extracted)
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: Needs traces; RCAEval RE1 has metrics only

idea: Test robustness when traces are missing or services are uninstrumented
problem_it_solves: Authors report trace-centric search breaks on blind spots
evidence_in_source: not-reported (limitation only)
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: None: RCAEval exposes metrics/logs/traces separately

idea: Score evidence correctness: every cited evidence item must exist in the observed telemetry
problem_it_solves: Detects hallucinated evidence in explanations
evidence_in_source: Evidence correctness 1.00 by construction; Top-1/3 accuracy on RCAEval RE2+RE3 in Sec 9.1 Table 1 (values not captured in the extraction record)
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: Requires structured output (JSON with evidence ids)

idea: Report LLM calls, tokens and wall time per incident; Wilcoxon + Holm across baselines
problem_it_solves: Makes cost comparable and tests significance
evidence_in_source: 9.2 calls and 13,800 tokens per incident vs 13.4-18.8 calls for agent baselines; 48.6 s mean wall time
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: None

idea: Human checkpoints at verification steps; evaluate explanations with human rating besides BLEU/BERTScore
problem_it_solves: BLEU/BERTScore do not measure correctness (authors' own limitation)
evidence_in_source: Top-1 73.33/76.67/68.29 vs 44.44/43.33/51.22 for prompted GPT-4o; BLEU-4 63.45, BERTScore 86.92 on D2
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: Human time cost not measured in source; plan rater budget

idea: Fine-tune a 3B model with staged RL (GRPO) and a localization reward
problem_it_solves: Makes a small open model competitive and fast
evidence_in_source: MRR 48.51 -> 62.93 across stages (Llama3.2-3B); latency minutes -> seconds
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: Source uses AIOps 2022 only; RL needs many labelled cases

idea: Count a diagnosis as correct only if humans judge the reasoning sensible (HEval)
problem_it_solves: Penalises right answers for wrong reasons
evidence_in_source: HEval 0.500/0.669 vs human DBA 0.720/0.806
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: Database domain; criteria must be rewritten for microservices

idea: Retrieve paths in a knowledge graph of diagnosis experience instead of text chunks
problem_it_solves: Chunk RAG returns generic text
evidence_in_source: R1-32B 0.92 vs LLM-only 0.57; >37%/45% HEval over D-Bot/ChatDBA
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: No diagnosis documents for RCAEval systems; KG must be built by hand

idea: Text-to-PromQL with a system-context knowledge graph so the LLM can query metrics itself
problem_it_solves: LLM cannot read all metrics; let it query
evidence_in_source: 280-pair benchmark on TrainTicket; QueryAcc in Table 2 (value not extracted); 59% of failures at final generation
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: RCAEval gives offline files, not a live Prometheus; tool layer must be emulated

idea: Interpretable root cause score from self/upstream/downstream reconstruction errors with learned weights
problem_it_solves: Explains why a service is ranked first (supervisor note: a->b)
evidence_in_source: 0.169 s online per failure on CPU; A@k in Table 2 (values not extracted)
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: Needs instance graph; RCAEval has service call info via traces only in RE2/RE3

idea: Counterfactual explanation: replace a component's data by normal patterns and see if the anomaly disappears
problem_it_solves: Answers 'why this component' with an intervention
evidence_in_source: 2.13 s (TT) / 2.48 s (SN) per case
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: Normal pattern library needs normal data per service; RCAEval has pre-fault windows

idea: Learn a propagation graph with topology as soft prior; separate root cause from downstream symptoms
problem_it_solves: Distinguishes root cause service from victims (a->b->c)
evidence_in_source: Hit@1 0.872/0.901 on AIOps2022/TT
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: No edge-level ground truth (authors' limitation); evaluate only node-level

idea: Simulate missing metrics chunk-wise and point-wise up to 40% and report degradation
problem_it_solves: Robustness protocol for incomplete telemetry
evidence_in_source: F1 under increasing missing rates in Sec 4.7 (values not extracted)
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: Anomaly detection in source, RCA here; same masking protocol applies

idea: Convert metrics/logs/traces into unified alerts and learn which modality helps which task
problem_it_solves: Multimodal fusion without manual feature design
evidence_in_source: HR@1 on 4 datasets incl. SockShop with Chaos Mesh; alert extraction dominates time (Table 9)
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: Supervised; few labels per RCAEval system

idea: Cheap baseline: trace anomaly score correlated (Spearman) with each metric to rank culprit metrics
problem_it_solves: Metric-level evidence for the LLM at near-zero cost
evidence_in_source: HR@k at service and metric level on TrainTicket/SocialNetwork; ~1 s per 1,000 spans
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: Needs traces and metrics together; sensitive to trace sampling

idea: Pre-aggregate structured telemetry before analysis (frequent item-sets with lift filter)
problem_it_solves: Reduces data volume before reasoning
evidence_in_source: Pre-aggregation reduces data 200x and 500x; data prep 10x and 18x faster
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: Production structured logs in source; RCAEval logs are unstructured and need parsing first

idea: Separate retrieval errors from generation errors and measure hallucination rate with a validated LLM judge
problem_it_solves: Tells whether a wrong answer came from bad context or bad reasoning
evidence_in_source: Hybrid + rerank generally improves faithfulness; judge-human agreement ~95%
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: QA domain; RCA correctness is checkable against labels, judge only needed for explanations

idea: Instruct the model to answer 'Unknown' when evidence is insufficient; track verbosity ratio and tokens
problem_it_solves: Reduces over-long, ungrounded answers
evidence_in_source: Verbosity ratio ~216 without instructions vs ~4 with; EM 0.45 vs 0.00
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: Abstention changes AC@k; report coverage together (see I06)

idea: Critical-path analysis over RPC traces to estimate which errors actually drive latency
problem_it_solves: Explains propagation of latency from callee to caller
evidence_in_source: Case study 30% tail latency reduction at Uber
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: Estimates assume erroring spans removable; RCAEval traces are smaller

idea: Structure the evidence into canonical blocks and supervise the decision path when fine-tuning
source_locator: Sec I contributions; results on TelecomTS
problem_it_solves: Aligns the LLM with structured numeric telemetry
evidence_in_source: SEKA-FT Acc 0.647 vs 0.132 (SFT + structured) and <=0.061 (ICL) on TelecomTS
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: Telecom KPIs; needs decision-path labels that RCAEval does not provide

idea: Two-phase retrieval: dense retrieve then bounded LLM rerank of a short list; report cost per item
problem_it_solves: Cheaper than full agent exploration
evidence_in_source: $0.0017 per bug with GPT-OSS-120B vs $1.65 effective for LocAgent
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: Code localization in source; candidate list here = services

idea: Cache LLM answers for repeated inputs and report token consumption
problem_it_solves: Avoids paying twice for repeated patterns
evidence_in_source: Inference under 1 s per sequence; token table Sec 5.5.1
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: Incidents rarely repeat exactly; cache by template/fault signature

idea: Post-hoc decision-tree surrogate to explain a neural suspicious score
problem_it_solves: Gives human-readable rules for a ranking
evidence_in_source: Surrogate reported in Sec 4 (fidelity values not extracted)
risk_when_moved_to_rcaeval: Supervised source model; surrogate fidelity must be measured
